name: SG9 reciprocal self-attention propagation
tie_break: within 0.002 prefer the operator closest to REF: R3 soft gate, then R1 geometric, then R2 minimum
selection: operator and threshold selected independently for W and T on four VOC-Sim folds and scored on the held-out fold
transfer: COCO-Cap uses the operator and threshold chosen on VOC-Sim and never selects
storage: compact counts and per-image reciprocal diagnostics only; generated images, maps, affinities, and propagated values are discarded
